about: Dieppe is a city beside Moncton in southeastern New Brunswick, on the Petitcodiac River tidal flats. It is a largely francophone community within Greater Moncton, with newer commercial corridors along Champlain Street and residential neighbourhoods toward the airport. The city grew rapidly as Moncton’s east-side twin. About 28,000 people live in Dieppe.
seoSummary: Francophone city beside Moncton on the Petitcodiac, a fast-growing part of Greater Moncton.
